abstract: A retroperitoneal teratoma was studied with CT and magnetic resonance (MR) imaging. The images were correlated with the pathologic findings. The tumor was composed of five portions: adipose tissue, bone, hair, sebum, and loose edematous fibrofatty tissue with skin. Computed tomography and MR both demonstrated a well defined mass with separate cystic and solid components and all five tissue elements of the tumor. Magnetic resonance was superior to CT in delineating the relationship of blood vessels to the tumor.
abstract_ja: 後腹膜奇形腫の1例をコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)および磁気共鳴(MR)画像法で検討し、画像所見を病理所見と対比した。腫瘍は脂肪組織、骨、毛髪、皮脂、そして皮膚を伴う浮腫性の線維脂肪組織の5つの成分から構成されていた。CTとMRはいずれも、嚢胞成分と充実成分を分けて示す境界明瞭な腫瘤と、腫瘍の5つの組織成分すべてを描出した。血管と腫瘍の関係の描出においては、MRがCTより優れていた。
